text:
marta: POC kick — Aurora Financial. Asking for streaming SDK (browser + server), function/tool calling, and deterministic JSON output for downstream rules engine. Blocking items: on-prem option, customer KMS, audit export (12mo), and steady 120 QPS sustained.
lee: Quick clarifier: is 120 QPS steady requests or responses? Avg tokens/out?
marta: Requests ~120 QPS. Avg model tokens out ~80, some flows call 1 external tool.
devin: From infra side: hosted can handle but costs scale. Recommend Dedicated for steady load or a commit rate. We should sketch 3 pricing lanes: pay-as-you-go hosted, reserved dedicated, and private deployment license.
samir: Security ask: they want CMK support + ability to push audit logs to their SIEM. Also need proof of SOC2 and encryption-in-transit certs. I can start the questionnaire.
marta: Also legal got a note: data residency EU-only and a contract clause for data purge on termination.
lee: For streaming SDK: we support SSE and websocket. Browser use-case -> short-lived tokens. Server -> longer TTL with rotation. Sample refresh flow in runbook.
devin: Handshake snippet for token exchange (pseudo):
```
POST /auth/issue-temp
body: {"client_id":"pocteam","grant":"stream"}
resp: {"token":"ey...","expires_in":300}
// client connects websocket with token in query or header
```
samir: Tool calling: our agent returns a structured call payload: {"action":"call","tool":"payment_lookup","params":{}}. We can validate schema server-side and reject malformed calls.
lee: Note: structured outputs reduce token variability. Recommend strict JSON schema + schema enforcement flag for POC.
devin: Ops note: long-lived streams + KV cache warmup can reduce cost. We'll propose prefix caching and batching for similar reqs to cut token spend ~20%.
salesbot: Ticket created: POC-AUR-1087 (assigned: sales-eng).
samir: For KMS: we offer CMK options in Dedicated and Private. Hosted supports envelope encryption with customer-managed keys via BYOK for EU regions (need to confirm). I'll loop in kms-team.
marta: Action items: @lee prepare sample client (browser + node) showing token refresh + streaming + tool call. @devin draft pricing lanes and rough monthly numbers (include audit retention addon). @samir start sec questionnaire answers and list docs. I'll schedule a working session with Aurora sec next Wed 14:00 CET.
lee: I'll have JS + Python examples by EOD tomorrow.
devin: I'll model cost using 80 tokens * 120 QPS * 30d +- caching. Will include dedicated hourly GPU sizing.
samir: I'll attach SOC2 report + initial answers once ready. Also confirm SIEM syslog export path.
marta: One more: they asked about fallback if dedicated capacity is exhausted. We can route to quantized smaller model in a different region as fallback; note regression risk to product. Add to runbook.
lee: Agreed. We'll include a sample policy: prefer same-region dedicated -> same-region hosted fallback -> cross-region quantized.
salesbot: Reminder: calendar invite sent for POC kick and sec sync.
marta: Thanks team. Keep responses tight so I can forward summary to Aurora. :rocket:
